editorial:
You step into a cold city morgue where a recovering cop named Megan works the night shift, and the quiet halls quickly turn into a nightmare when a strange corpse starts causing real trouble. The movie leans on shadows, locked doors, and that uneasy feeling that something is watching from the dark, so if you like creepy hospital stories, you will feel right at home. It is not a big, loud horror movie, but it keeps you tense as Megan tries to stay sober and survive one long, scary night.

The acting is solid, especially the lead, and the morgue setting gives the film a strong, creepy look. The downside is that the story feels thin, some scares repeat, and the ending may leave you wanting more. Still, it is a decent pick for a late-night horror watch with friends. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Megan realizes the corpse is possessed by a demon that feeds on fear and pain, and it keeps healing itself as it attacks. She fights back, uses the morgue tools and fire, and finally destroys the body, but the last shot hints the evil may not be fully gone. The twist is that the demon was never just a dead body; it was an active monster hiding in plain sight.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creepy morgue horror and late-night scares.
